value.rationale: The distribution of the actual angular separation between a pair of rare transverse homoclinic splitting phases is a natural dynamical observable not determined by their frequency. The exact finite-harmonic CDF, Maxwell amplitude-selection mechanism, exact angular uniformity, and arbitrary-harmonic-cutoff high-frequency universality provide a substantive structural law rather than re-counting zeros.
